The '''Chavana''' "brothers" are four acrobats who are with [[Valan Luca]]'s [[Valan Luca's Traveling Show|traveling show]]. By their appearances they are not related by blood. The three that have been described are all short and compact.

*[[Barit Chavana]] - a dark man with ''[[Atha'an Miere]]'' tattoos.
*[[Brugh Chavana]] - another of the brothers.
*[[Taeric Chavana]] - a green-eyed, high-cheek-boned man with a hooked nose indicative of [[Saldaea]].
*The fourth Chavana brother is never named.
